name: BSP_PlaneBot_ApproachBaseStep
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_airfield_taxi, read-only analysis. __thiscall(task, float dt), RET 4, body 009B22C0-009B2C68. Ghidra has no function here; the vtable 00D1FF60 holds it at slot +0Ch. The sibling of 009CD540 for a plane heading to a base it is not yet attached to: the target site comes from the context at (task+4)+34h rather than plane+BF4h, and it fails only when the plane is already attached (byte plane+BF8h set and plane+BF4h non-null) and that target's owner is dead. Reads the queue origin through site->vtable[44h] = 006CF520, keeps its Z, then the taxi target through site->vtable[2Ch] = 006CF420, and runs the identical 4-to-5 switch at 009B271A-009B273A. Coverage: partial, only the head, the switch and the queue read were reduced. docs/AIRFIELD_TAXI.md

name: BSP_BotStateMoveTo_SetRanges
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc8_torpedo_moveto_tick, read-only, complete. void __thiscall(state, float a, float b, float c): three stores into state+30h, +34h and +38h and nothing else. Its torpedo call site passes (approach+3Ch + approach+34h, the same value again, task+438h), so both altitude slots carry the task's aim altitude - docs/BOT_TASK_STATES.md line 262 identifies the depth charge's twin as a draw between Pilot/DepthCharge/AimAltRange/1 = 20 and /2 = 60 - and +38h carries the distance at which the glide slope is to reach it. The tick 009C18C0 uses +34h and +30h as max(this+34h + targetY, this+30h), the glide's base altitude, and +38h as 009FBA50's rangeLow, which REFUTES docs/BOT_TASK_STATES.md's reading of 009C2AC0's constructor parameters as near/far/mode: the last is a distance, not a mode. docs/TORPEDO_MOVETO_TICK.md. | Packet cc8_dive_approach: the DIVE-BOMB call site is 009C8825, inside 009C8790 BSP_BotTaskDiveBomb_TickArm and run EVERY tick on the moveto state task+4F0h, with (task+4A4h - 100.0 [FSUB qword 00D7A220], task+4A4h, task+4ACh) = (approach+ACh - 100, approach+ACh, approach+B4h). The dive task's CONSTRUCTOR 009C7436 passes the same shape but off approach+A8h, so the per-tick pair wins from the first tick. approach+ACh is ctl+398h, Pilot/DiveBomb/BeginAltRange/1. docs/DIVE_BOMB_APPROACH.md.

name: BSP_BotStateFollow_Enter_Provisional
evidence: PROVISIONAL. Packet cc8_formation, read only for its one formation call. Callees 0042E740 BSP_GameTuning_GetSingleton, 00694A60 BSP_Observer_RegisterPair, 006952A0 BSP_Observer_UnregisterPair, 007ED260 and 009BE150; callers 009C7240 BSP_BotStateDiveBombDone_Enter and 009D2530 BSP_BotStateTorpedoDone_Enter. Its call to 007ED260 is what assigns the squadron's formation indices, so a wing gets its stations when the follow state is entered and not at spawn: 007D01C3 zeroes plane+9D0h in the plane constructor and 007F4B43 never writes it. docs/PLANE_FORMATION.md. | CORRECTION (same packet): this is not the only site that assigns the indices. tools/callsite_census.py 007ed260 returns nine call sites, including 007F4BFA inside the spawn tail 007F4580, so a wing has its indices from spawn; 009BEDE4 re-runs the assignment on the follow entry.

name: BSP_BotStateFollow_CommandStep
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc8_follow_law; supersedes BSP_BotStateFollow_TickThirdStep_Provisional (cc8_done_state), whose structural reading is retained below and whose behavioural framing is CORRECTED. __thiscall(this=ESI, float dt), RET 4 at 009BFD65, body 009BEE30-009BFD67. One call site image-wide, 009C2077 in 009C1FD0, third after 009BFD70 and 009BFEE0; 009BEE36 MOV ESI,ECX and 009C206D FLD [ESP+74h] passes the tick's own dt. CORRECTION: the prior record and docs/PLANE_FORMATION.md section 6 call 009BFEE0 the station-keeping LAW that flies the member. 009BFEE0 commands nothing - all fifteen of its distinct callees are math/pose primitives (00414DB0 x13, 0042CF10 x7, 0042BE90 x4, 00BF7030 x3, 00438B10 x3, 00415510, 00415550, 00419510, 00414C60, 00419010, 00419260, 0042B2F0) and it only produces a steer point at state+44h/48h/4Ch. 009BEE30 is the body that issues every follow command. 009BEE42 sets [[approach+18h]+2E5h]=1 unconditionally; 009BEE49 CMP byte [ESI+85h],0 / JZ 009BF9EA splits on the GoodPosition flag with the same polarity as 009BFEEE. GOOD-POSITION ARM 009BEE56-009BF9E5, still unread apart from the prior record's reading: 009BEEF2 EBP=[ESI+2Ch] the flight leader; 009BEEFC JZ out when none; 009BEF09 requires the leader's published unit+520h; four float tests 009BF086-009BF0B6; 009BF0B8 MOV byte [EBX+520h],1 and 009BF0C4 plan target := the leader, which are gate A conditions 2 and 3 of 0099D300. FLY-TO ARM 009BF9EA-009BFD38 now READ IN FULL: heading 009BF9F0 CALL 009F9E40 CommandHeadingToPoint with LEA EBP,[ESI+44h], i.e. at 009BFEE0's steer point; cmd+2E8h := block+38h at 009BFA00; altitude 009BFC21 CALL 009F9ED0 (RET 8) with error = lerp(stationY=state+34h, steerY=state+48h, min(dStation/dSteer,1)) - own pose+100h, and distance = max(dStation, block+00h FollowedPointDist); speed = 00419010(MaxFollowSpdTargetDir, 00419010(0, leaderSpd, GoodPositionDist, TurboMultiplier*max(leaderSpd, classDesc+188h), dStation), MinFollowSpdTargetDir, 007C47F0*0.9, alignmentCosine) stored to cmd+2B4h at 009BFD0F, with cmd+2B0h=0 and cmd+2D8h=1. state+6Ch is the tuning singleton at its +380h. Two traps: the five floats of 00419010 are assembled across two stack windows with a 0-arg virtual between them (arity from RET 14h, not from SUB ESP,0Ch), and 009BFC58/009BFCC3 are two separate calls of the same virtual with only the first floored. See docs/PLANE_FOLLOW_LAW.md.

name: BSP_BotStateFollow_UpdateStationPoint
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc8_formation, read from the listing, complete. __fastcall(state /*ECX*/), body 009BFD70-009BFED6, 108 instructions. The first half of the follow tick 009C1FD0. 009BFD76 ECX=[state+4] the task context; 009BFD84 EAX=[[ECX+0Ch]+3D0h], the squadron's member array slot 0 = the flight leader, JZ out when either is null; 009BFD92 CMP EAX,[ECX+4] / JZ 009BFEB1, so the flight leader does not follow itself; 009BFDA1 006CEF40(state+18h, leader); 009BFDA6-009BFDB2 [squadron+3E8h] = [state+8Ch], the morale republish; 009BFDBE MOV ECX,[[ECX+4]+9D0h], the unit's own formationIndex, pushed with EBP=state+30h and ECX=squadron into 009BFDCC CALL 007F23A0. 009BFDEE-009BFE19 then takes the vector from the unit's own world position (unit+0FCh..104h) to the station and its length through 0042B2F0, and 009BFE24 compares it with [[state+6Ch]+18h]. Sole caller 009C1FD0 at 009C1FEA. docs/PLANE_FORMATION.md.

name: BSP_BotStateFollow_StationKeepingStep_Provisional
evidence: PROVISIONAL and NOT READ. Packet cc8_formation named it from its position only: it is the second call of the follow tick 009C1FD0 (at 009C1FF?), immediately after 009BFD70 has produced the wing member's station. Body 009BFEE0-009C1846, 1795 instructions, 210 basic blocks, 297 edges, 55 calls, cyclomatic complexity 89. Hypothesis, on the size and the Pilot/Follow tuning block that surrounds it, that it is the law that flies a member to the station (GoodPositionDist, GoodPositionDir, NearbyDist, WaitForHdgDiff, LeaderHeadingSpdTime/Dist, TightTurn and the yf_/pf_/rf_/pwr_ gains). No line of it was read; the name must not be relied on. docs/PLANE_FORMATION.md section 5. | Packet cc8_after_task, docs/BOMBER_AFTER_TASK.md section 6. __thiscall(state), plain RET at 009C181D/009C1833/009C1846 so NO stack argument (dt does not reach it). 1795 instructions, 210 blocks, 55 calls. 009BFEEE CMP byte [state+85h],0 / 009BFEF6 JE 009C0026 splits it in two: set -> arm A 009BFEFC-009C0021 (~50 instructions, the station HOLD) then JMP to the common tail; clear -> arm B 009C0026-009C16D1 (~1500 instructions, the fly-TO-station law, UNREAD). state+85h is GoodPosition, written by 009BFD70 from block+18h (distance, 009BFE21) and block+14h (heading dot, 009BFE83) off the cached Pilot/Follow block at state+6Ch. Arm A: station point state+30h into the own frame (004142E0), copied to state+44h/48h/4Ch (009BFFB1/B7/BD), plus the leader's heading axis scaled by a ratio from block+0h (009BFF9C). Common tail 009C16D2-009C1846 read whole: clamps around leader+100h using block+4h, the double [00D1F3F8] and tuning+210h, writes state+34h (009C17F1) and clamps state+48h. Outside esp it writes only esi+34h, esi+44h..68h and ebx+10Ch. 009C1FD0 then calls 009BEE30 (009BEE30-009BFD67, 3895 bytes, also unread).
